g.text: AICS DISBURSEMENT & FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM • MUNICIPALITY OF DAANBANTAYAN, CEBU

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-desc: Municipal Treasurer securely authenticates via /login and navigates to the dedicated Treasury operations dashboard.
Accesses the queue of social worker approved assistance requests awaiting financial verification and release scheduling.
Cross-references the approved grant amount in PHP against beneficiary records, emergency crisis classification, and municipal ceiling.
Audits attached legal documentation: Certificate of Indigency, Valid Government ID, Medical Abstract/Hospital Bills, or Funeral Contract.
Treasurer validates all documentary attachments and approved amounts. Discrepancies trigger Return to Admin; verified files proceed to Fund Inspection.

g.data-title: Return Request with Notes to Admin
g.data-desc: Invokes action: return_request via /api/treasury. Sets remarks with correction notes and notifies MSWDO Social Worker for resolution.
Inspects municipal treasury reserves for specific assistance category: Medical, Burial, Educational, Food, or Transportation.
Validates that target fund current_balance >= amount_approved. Overdrafts are programmatically blocked by database rules.
Examines pending encumbrances, exhausted category balances, and historical municipal general fund appropriations.
Evaluates if internal adjustment, inter-fund realignment, or municipal general fund replenishment can restore liquidity.
System generates automated warning notifications alerting Admin and Local Chief Executive of fund exhaustion.
Treasurer transmits formal supplemental appropriation request to the Municipal Mayor and Sangguniang Bayan.
Assistance application remains queued in 'Pending Release' state with encumbered reservation until liquidity is cleared.
Legislative & executive review determines whether supplemental emergency allocation is granted for the program.
Treasurer initiates the Disbursement Voucher creation modal and links verified beneficiary and grant details.
Inputs standardized DV Number (DV-YYYY-XXXX), assigns payment method (Cash / Check / Bank), and records Disbursing Officer.
Sets release_status = 'Ready for Release' and dispatches real-time broadcast notification to Admin that funds are prepped.
Beneficiary or authorized representative presents physical government ID card and signs the Treasury assistance payroll sheet.
Final physical verification of recipient identity, signature match, and presence at the Municipal Disbursing counter.
Municipal Treasurer hands over the cash grant or official municipal check to the verified beneficiary with acknowledgment receipt.
Calls action: confirm_release via /api/treasury. Sets requests.status = 'Released', updates release_status = 'Released'.
Atomically deducts fund balance, increments total_released, inserts debit row in fund_transactions, and logs audit trail.
Confirms ledger synchronization, checks remaining balance against low_balance_threshold, and prepares transaction for COA liquidation.
Release is withheld due to beneficiary absence, signature mismatch, documentary deficiency, or budget exhaustion. Request held for review.
Disbursement successfully concluded. Fund ledger updated, resident notified, and transaction queued for COA/DSWD liquidation reports.
